construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated implementation using clearly labeled synthetic fixtures.

shared_schema.input: Exact root keys: schema_version, synthetic=true, catalog[], customer, basket, clickstream[], research.
shared_schema.catalog: Products: unique sku, name, description, nonnegative fixed-point price string, USD/EUR/GBP currency, nonnegative integer stock. Names/descriptions exclude numeric/price/stock claims and review/endorsement vocabulary; unknown fields rejected.
shared_schema.basket: id and unique SKU/positive integer quantity items; quantities cannot exceed catalog stock; no mixed currencies.
shared_schema.clickstream: Unique id, current customer_id, catalog sku, view/add_to_basket event, ISO timezone-aware timestamp.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, query, personalized, findings[], sources[], priced basket, notice, no_matches. Error envelope contains schema_version, status=error, error.
shared_schema.citation: source_id references emitted source text; start/end are exact Unicode character offsets, end exclusive. input_pointer identifies source catalog record.

cross_stage_handoffs: Catalog records become deterministic source passages preserving exact description strings and structured catalog prices/stock.
Token-overlap retrieval ranks passages by matched query-token count, then consent-gated click counts, then SKU.
Extractive findings quote complete selected passages, attach exact citations and catalog values; output evidence invariants are checked.

behavior.retrieval: Case-insensitive ASCII alphanumeric token intersection; no matches produces successful empty findings. No paraphrasing or factual generation.
behavior.personalization: Disabled by default in fixture; uses only supplied clickstream counts to break retrieval ties when affirmative consent exists and CCPA opt-out is false. Otherwise explicit requests fail. Persona text is not used for ranking.
behavior.catalog_fidelity: Price and stock in findings, source passages and basket are read directly from the validated feed. Basket sums use integer cents.
behavior.endorsements: Review fields and conservative review/endorsement vocabulary are rejected. Findings never synthesize user reviews. This lexical demonstration does not verify truth of arbitrary input prose.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout, success exit 0; input/file errors produce JSON status=error and exit 2.

included: Single-stage bounded deterministic research over synthetic retail catalog
Synthetic customer and clickstream event log with consent-gated ranking
Basket reference validation and exact monetary totals
Shared validation and exact source citations
excluded: Live providers, networks, external dependencies and LLM calls
External corpus ingestion, semantic search and production-scale indexing
Checkout, inventory mutation, tax, shipping and currency conversion
Legal compliance certification, consent lifecycle management and production deployment

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: exit 0, one JSON object with status=ok
test_outcomes.unittest_result: 19 tests passed, including subprocess CLI success and missing-file errors.
